Cost: 0eb (with ads)

A video website focus on Exotic porn and the official website for the Animals owned strip club "The Zoo". Also comes as an app with the icon of a suggestively winking lioness. Most people keep it hidden in inconspicuously named folders. You can pay 20eb to remove ads for 30 days.

Foundry notes:

  • Setting flavor: no rules effect.
  • Removing the ads costs 20eb for 30 days.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Apps).
